items.text: One writer for `shownMenu`, so the panel's input freeze and the hover arming always agree with what is on screen. A menu opened by click lands under the pointer, which chose no row of it, so it opens disarmed. A searchable menu takes the keyboard into its filter, and gives it back to the search field when it closes.
